title: 12" bird love clock
text: 12" bird love clock. What a shame.  Opened the box, put the battery in and the sweep hand gets stuck between 3 and 9.  Jerks a bit... moves a tiny bit.  Until the 9 then it sweeps again... However, it can't keep time that way.  If you could get to the face you MIGHT be able to fix it.. I think the second hand is too close to the glass between the 3 and 9 - seems bent.  The other thing that was really disappointing... before I realized it wasn't working, I hung it.  If you use the hole in the back meant to hang the clock, it hangs crooked!!!  The weight of the clock and the back setting is misaligned some how!  It's really too bad because the clock is cute.  It's just really poor craftsmanship.  It's really a shame the seller even sends these out.  I recommend they check before sending or reject the current stock.  I would have really liked to have this clock IF, of course, it had worked.  Very disappointed.  For the price, it should have worked flawlessly.  It has a brushed metal frame and I believe, real glass.  A real shame that quality is not as important as material.

description: This 12" creative wall clock with a silver frame and two birds cartoon pattern adds a nice touch to any home design. With a quiet and smooth sweeping movement of the clock hands, you can be assured of a peaceful environment for your work or rest time. Easy to maintain and clean.
